description: Main React component for a Next.js front-end page that manages persona creation and editing workflows, including file uploads, orchestration calls, version management, and UI interactions in a multi-step process.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component managing persona workflow UI, including state, effects, and user interactions.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates uploaded files against allowed extensions (.pdf, .docx, .txt).

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds valid files to the uploaded files state, respecting maximum allowed count.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file input change event, processes new files for upload.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop file upload.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Handles drag over event to allow drop.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from uploaded list by id.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers backend orchestration to generate persona draft, handles status polling and error states.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves current persona data to backend, updates version list.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Transitions to final state, marking persona as finalized.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-initiates draft generation for current build, with error handling.

methods.name: refreshVersions
methods.description: Loads persona version history from backend.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from persona skills list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to persona skills list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles profile image upload, creates object URL, updates persona data.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested values in orchestration response data.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs keys present in orchestration response for debugging shape issues.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON payloads from complex orchestration responses.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend persona JSON into UI-compatible PersonaData shape.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a lightweight fingerprint string for persona data to detect changes.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint for raw backend persona artifacts to prevent redundant applies.
